    What happens to my prompt? +

    medAIte uses local, rule-based checks to organise your request, spot common gaps and suggest optional cuts. It is not calling an AI model, and it may miss nuance or unusual requirements.

    Your prompt stays in this browser tab. It is not sent to an AI service or saved by this page. Copy it into the AI tool you want to use. Refreshing or closing this tab clears your work.

    Your original requirements are kept. Added details are labelled, and unanswered questions remain questions. You decide what to remove.
